name: Hive
label: Hive HQ API v2
description: Hive HQ API v2 via OfficialApiNode (nodes/hive/api_spec.json). Official Hive HQ REST v2 (app.hive.com/api/v2) — not TheHive incident-response product. API access is often plan-gated. Official docs: https://developers.hive.com/reference/introduction. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data} or {error}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Hive official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"action_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'action_create', 'action_get', 'action_list', 'action_update', 'action_delete', 'project_create', 'project_get', 'project_list', 'project_delete', 'message_create', 'listen'. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: 'action_create'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code. Example: 200.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: action_create, action_get, action_list, action_update, action_delete, project_create, project_get, project_list, project_delete, message_create, listen. Default: action_create. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event. Example: action_create.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey api_key). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: User Id
configurationParameters.description: Hive user_id query param sent on every request. REQUIRED. Example: '5f8a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
